name: dependency_audit
description: Scan a project's dependencies for known vulnerabilities (CVEs). Call with manager='pip' and a requirements.txt-style content, or manager='npm' and a package.json/package-lock.json content, to check every listed package/version against public vulnerability databases (via pip-audit / npm audit under the hood). Runs inside the user's sandbox, same as @terminal — nothing leaves the sandbox except the outbound audit request each tool makes to its own vulnerability database.

content.description: The raw content of requirements.txt (for pip) or package.json (for npm).

project_path.description: Alternative to 'content': a path (relative to the user's sandbox) to an existing requirements.txt or package.json already on disk, e.g. from a cloned repo via @terminal or @github.
